module_role: Wire-level inter-IC digital-audio serial bus specification. Defines a 3-line streaming-audio interface between any two (or more) I2S-compatible ICs. Concrete I2S controller / target IP blocks implement this protocol behind an MCU register interface (per SoC integration).

integration_overview.wire_directions: SCK + WS: controller → target; SD: transmitter → receiver (one-way per direction)
integration_overview.no_chip_select: No CS / SS line; the bus is a pure point-to-point stream.
integration_overview.no_addressing: No device addressing; one transmitter + one receiver per direction.
integration_overview.controller_choices: Transmitter, receiver, OR separate system controller can be the SCK+WS source.
integration_overview.no_handshake: Continuous streaming; no ACK, no flow control.

interface_categories: Transmitter (drives SD; may also drive SCK + WS if it is the controller)
Receiver (consumes SD; may drive SCK + WS if it is the controller)
System Controller (drives SCK + WS only; both transmitter and receiver are targets)
interconnect_topologies_supported: Multi-receiver broadcast (one transmitter + multiple receivers sharing the same SCK/WS/SD)
Multi-transmitter selected by system controller (rare; requires external MUX of SD)
default_signal_values_when_omitted: Implementation-defined idle level for SCK + WS; controller stops driving SCK to halt streaming gracefully.
soc_dependent_items: I2S controller / target IP register file (FIFO control, sample rate, bit clock divisor, word length, channel format select, mute, interrupt enable).
Master clock (MCLK) generation if needed for the codec — NOT part of the 3-wire I2S spec but commonly required for audio codecs.
Audio sample rate selection (44.1 kHz, 48 kHz, 96 kHz, 192 kHz, etc.).
Bit clock division: SCK = sample_rate × channels × bits_per_sample.
Interrupt routing for FIFO over/underflow events.
DMA-controller wiring for streaming audio data.

low_power_modes.Stop_SCK: Controller stops driving SCK to halt streaming; receivers idle.
low_power_modes.Mute: Per-implementation; not part of the 3-wire I2S protocol.
